title: Thunder Substack (by Andreea Popa): We're not made to do life alone; people raise each other's bar
summary: Andreea Popa's July recap argues that Thunder is built around togetherness: bringing promising people close when paths cross, pairing newcomers so the unknown feels smaller, and caring about people beyond their role. It reports Cris's recurring reminder that "we don't have to fight our battles alone" and that he reminds her what she can do when she forgets.

principles.text: Don't let the moment pass when you meet people who fit the culture; bring them closer and see what becomes possible, even without an announced opportunity.
principles.quote: We never announced an opportunity. We just crossed paths. And when we meet people who feel right for the culture we’re trying to build, we don’t really like letting the moment pass.

principles.text: Cris's recurring message: nobody should fight their battles alone. Support from the leader and peers carries people through hard stretches.
principles.quote: But as Cris always points out, we don’t have to fight our battles alone.

principles.text: Leaders and teammates remind people of their capability when they forget it, and share energy when theirs is gone.
principles.quote: Cris, who reminds me what I’m capable of when I forget.

principles.text: Pair people on new challenges so the unknown shrinks and the win is shared ("look what we did together").
principles.quote: But in a way, the unknown got a little smaller because neither of them had to step into it alone.

principles.text: Care about people beyond the role that brought them in: know their dreams and make room for them to grow.
principles.quote: We want to care about the people we bring close beyond the role that brought them through the door. To know what they dream about, what they hope to build for themselves, and, whenever we can, make a little more room for those dreams to grow.

principles.text: Live in a way that raises the bar for those around you; example-setting is among the most powerful things we can do for each other.
principles.quote: I truly believe that’s one of the most powerful things we can do for each other – to live in a way that raises the bar for the people around us.
